item.title: Random k-fold flattered my model by 3%. A new region cost 45%.
item.description: What a validation-first canopy-height model taught me about where ML error actually comes from in Earth observation, and why calibrated intervals are not the same as accurate ones.

item.title: Test your pipeline against injected truth before you touch real data
item.description: Why I build a synthetic backend with known answers before running any real data, and an honest scorecard of what my synthetic test bed got right and wrong.
